How we keep your brand safe

Big or small, your brand deserves clean, original work you can use with confidence.

Original work

No copyrighted characters, logos or artist names.

Consent first

No real person’s face is used without their permission.

A clear licence

You receive written usage rights once you have paid.

Your brand kit

Your colours, tone and look are saved, so every piece matches.

Quality checked

Every file is checked for AI errors before it reaches you.

Two revisions

Small changes are included, and the price is agreed first.

How it works

  1. Talk to us. Message us for a free chat about what you need.
  2. Get a clear quote. Orders under $50 are paid in full. Larger orders need a 50% deposit.
  3. We create. You see a watermarked preview.
  4. Two revision rounds. Small fixes like text, music, colour or trimming are included.
  5. Pay and download. The watermark comes off and you receive the clean file.

FAQs

Can I use what I buy for my business?

Yes, for your own business. Prompts and stories can’t be resold or shared as your own product.

Can I get a refund?

Custom work is agreed before we start. Digital prompts and stories can’t be refunded once delivered.

Will this make me sales?

We can’t promise sales or revenue. We make strong creative work that helps you show up well.

Let’s talk business.

Tell us what you do. We’ll show you where AI can help, and what it would cost.

Dark fantasy romance

What you’ll find here: Dark, emotional fantasy love stories full of danger and magic. Mature themes, no explicit content.

18+ only. This section has mature, dark themes. There is no explicit content.

THE KINGDOM OF HIS OBSESSION

He can command an empire. He cannot command her heart.

Genre: Dark Fantasy Romance • Royal Intrigue • Supernatural Mystery
Format: Digital PDF novel, 140 pages. This is a digital copy only. There is no physical book.

$4.99 digital PDF

Turn it into a film

📖 About the Story

She came to save her brother. She never expected to become the obsession of an immortal king.

Seraphina Vale will do anything to save seventeen-year-old Elias, even if it means entering the cursed kingdom of Veyrath and bargaining with its ruthless ruler, King Lucien Draven.

Powerful, arrogant, and feared throughout his empire, Lucien has spent centuries believing that everything can be controlled. But Seraphina refuses to bow to his authority, and the dangerous attraction growing between them threatens to awaken secrets buried beneath his throne.

Behind the palace walls lie forbidden magic, political conspiracies, an ancient curse, and a truth that could destroy the kingdom. When jealousy drives Lucien to commit an unforgivable act, Seraphina must decide whether the man she desires is worth the danger he brings, or whether loving him will cost her everything.

He can conquer kingdoms. He can command armies. But he cannot force her to love him.

🖤 What Awaits You Inside

  • A dangerously possessive king who refuses to surrender his power easily.
  • A fearless heroine who will not sacrifice her freedom for love.
  • Forbidden attraction, passionate encounters, and emotional tension.
  • Palace secrets, deadly rivalries, betrayal, and political conspiracies.
  • An ancient supernatural curse with the power to destroy an entire kingdom.
  • A devastating loss that changes everything.
  • A final battle where love, power, and survival collide.

✨ Is This Story for You?

If you love dark fantasy romance, morally complicated characters, powerful royal settings, forbidden attraction, supernatural mysteries, and love stories where forgiveness must be earned, this tale invites you into a kingdom where desire can be as dangerous as magic.

One king. One defiant woman. One cursed kingdom. A love that may destroy them both.

📥 Get Your Copy

Enter the kingdom of Veyrath and discover what happens when an immortal king meets the one woman he cannot control.

Download the digital PDF and begin reading today. It is a digital PDF only, with no physical book.

Want to see it on screen? We can turn this novel into an AI-generated film.

Terms of Service and refunds

Last updated: October 2026. By ordering from IBJSTUDIO you agree to these terms.

Our work

We create AI-assisted films, adverts, images, campaigns, prompts and stories. We agree the scope and price with you in writing (WhatsApp or email) before work begins.

Payment

Orders under $50 are paid in full before work starts. Larger orders need a 50% deposit, with the balance due before the final files are released. Prices are launch prices and may change for new orders.

Previews, revisions and delivery

You receive a watermarked preview first. Every project includes two rounds of revisions for small changes such as text, music, colour or trimming. A new idea or direction is a new project. The clean, full-quality files are sent after full payment.

Your licence

After full payment you may use the finished work for your own business and marketing. You may not resell it as your own product or claim it was made without AI. AI tools can produce similar results for different people, so we cannot promise exclusivity or legal copyright over AI-generated material.

Prompts and stories

Prompts and stories are delivered privately after payment for your own use. You may not resell, share, publish or redistribute them. Because they are digital goods, they cannot be refunded once delivered.

Refunds

If we cancel or cannot deliver, you get a full refund of what you paid for that work. If you cancel before work starts, your payment is refunded. Once work has started, the deposit covers the time spent. Completed and delivered work is not refundable.

What you provide

You confirm you have the right to any logos, photos, text or ideas you send us, and that your project is lawful and not misleading or harmful.

No guarantees

We do not promise sales, followers or revenue. Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the order in question.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms, and the version on this page applies to new orders. Questions: hello@ibjstudio.com. These terms are governed by the laws of Nigeria.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026.

What we collect

The details you send us: your name, contact details, business information, project requirements and files, usually through WhatsApp or email. We do not collect payment card numbers. Payments are handled by a payment provider.

How we use it

To reply to you, quote, create and deliver your order, take payment, and keep records. We do not sell your personal data.

Who we share it with

Only service providers needed to run the business, such as WhatsApp, email, payment and hosting providers, and AI tools used to make your work. Do not send us anything you do not want processed by these services.

Keeping it

We keep project and payment records for as long as needed for the order, accounting and disputes, then delete or anonymise them.

Your rights

You may ask to see, correct or delete your personal data by emailing hello@ibjstudio.com. We handle personal data in line with applicable Nigerian data protection law.

Cookies

This site does not use tracking cookies at the moment. If that changes, we will update this page.
